DatabaseBootstrap._comment: Development applies EF migrations at startup so a fresh `docker compose up` needs no manual `dotnet ef database update`. Stays false in appsettings.json for every other environment.

TenantContext._comment: spec-15 minted TenantContext TTL (seconds); short-lived — OD-3 placeholder.

TenantContextSigningKeys._comment: DEV-ONLY spec-15 JWS signing keys (base64 HMAC secrets). Never real secrets; production keys come from the secret store / vault.
